test_data: tests build temporary spec folders, records and items files under tempfile directories; no shared data

surfaces.name: pathway skills and the /interphase command
surfaces.kind: Claude Code plugin skills (feature, bug, prototype, project, and the /interphase router command)
surfaces.driver: claude -p with --plugin-dir set to the build's worktree and --output-format stream-json --verbose, started from a scratch folder under the results folder, sending a plain user request; the transcript shows which skill ran and what it produced

surfaces.name: scout and spec-reviewer agents
surfaces.driver: claude -p with --plugin-dir set to the build's worktree and --output-format stream-json --verbose; the transcript shows the Agent dispatch and its result

surfaces.name: resume hook after compact or clear
surfaces.driver: python3 scripts/resume_context.py run with a SessionStart payload on stdin from a temporary folder holding an in-progress record, plus the project's tests/test_hooks.py and tests/test_resume_context.py

surfaces.name: spec, items and record checkers and the record renderer
surfaces.driver: python3 scripts/<script>.py run as the README shows against temporary spec folders, reading exit code and printed error and warning lines, plus the project's unittest modules for each script

surfaces.name: bug reproduction probe and tree guard
surfaces.driver: python3 scripts/probe.py and scripts/tree_guard.py run against a temporary git repository, plus tests/test_probe.py and tests/test_tree_guard.py

python.value: Python 3.9 or later on PATH as python3
python.recheck: read the Requirements section of README.md

claude cli.value: the claude CLI is on PATH and signed in, so claude -p sessions can run
claude cli.recheck: run claude --version and a one-line claude -p request

plugin root variable.value: hooks run with CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT set to the plugin folder

off_limits: pushing to or opening pull requests on the GitHub repository SatanshuMishra/interphase
installing or updating the interphase plugin in the person's own Claude Code configuration
writing spec packages, glossaries or decision records into the person's own repositories
